Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Jedi Academy Training Manual

See also: Force Powers

[Lightsaber Form, Dark Side]

You walk the thin line between darkness and light as you ferociously attack your foe.

Time: Standard Action

Targets: One enemy within reach

Make a Use the Force check. The result of the check determines the effect, if any:

DC EFFECT
20 You make a single melee attack with a Lightsaber against the target, dealing +1 die of damage if you hit.
25 You make a single melee attack with a Lightsaber against the target, dealing +2 dice of damage if you hit.
30 You make a single melee attack with a Lightsaber against the target, dealing +3 dice of damage if you hit.
35 You make a single melee attack with a Lightsaber against the target, dealing +4 dice of damage if you hit.

Lightsaber Form (Juyo): If you have the Juyo Talent, this Form Power does not have the [Dark Side] descriptor for you.

Special: You can spend a Force Point to use this Form Power at the end of a Charge.
